parameters.name: ScalingBehaviour
parameters.description: 配置自定义弹性行为，具体数据结构参考样例。

parameters.name: ScalingRuleEnable
parameters.description:
弹性策略的启用状态。

- **true**：启用

- **false**：禁用

parameters.name: ScalingRuleTrigger
parameters.description: 触发器策略，为ScalingRuleTriggerDTO的JSON格式，具体样式，请参见请求参数补充说明。

parameters.name: ScalingRuleType
parameters.description:
弹性策略类型，当前仅支持以下类型：
* trigger：触发器类型。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas update-application-scaling-rule --app-id 78194c76-3dca-418e-a263-cccd1ab40000 --scaling-rule-name cpu-trigger --scaling-rule-type trigger --scaling-rule-enable true --scaling-rule-metric 1 --scaling-rule-timer 1 --scaling-rule-trigger ScalingRuleTriggerDTO_...... --scaling-behaviour scaleUp_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_0_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Pods_,_value_:5,_periodSeconds_:15_,_scaleDown_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_300_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Percent_,_value_:200,_periodSeconds_:15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas PUT /pop/v1/eam/scale/application_scaling_rule --region cn-hangzhou --ScalingRuleMetric 1 --ScalingRuleTimer 1 --ScalingRuleTrigger 'ScalingRuleTriggerDTO_......' --ScalingRuleName 'cpu-trigger' --AppId '78194c76-3dca-418e-a263-cccd1ab40000' --ScalingRuleEnable true --ScalingBehaviour 'scaleUp_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_0_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Pods_,_value_:5,_periodSeconds_:15_,_scaleDown_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_300_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Percent_,_value_:200,_periodSeconds_:15' --ScalingRuleType trigger --header "Content-Type=application/json"
